deliverables_scope.text:
rdinated preparedness and response, using a license-free, sustainable, and nationally owned digital platform. The implemented system shall translate the technical recommendations, blueprint, and SRS into a fully functional, interoperable, and people-centred solution that strengthens disaster risk reduction, protects lives and livelihoods, and supports timely early action.

  1. Specific Objectives

The specific objectives of the assignment are to:

  • Configure and customize an existing, license-free EWS application (open-source or equivalent) to fully meet the functional and technical requirements defined in the approved blueprint and SRS, without developing a system from scratch.
  • Implement an integrated national EWS platform that operationalizes all four pillars of a MHEWS:
    • Risk Knowledge
    • Detection, Monitoring and Forecasting
    • Warning Dissemination and Communication
    • Preparedness and Response
  • Implement the MHEWS using a phased implementation approach, beginning with a priority hazard to validate system functionality, data-sharing workflows, and warning dissemination mechanisms before expanding the system to additional hazards, datasets, and dissemination channels

o support the development of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to govern operational workflows for the MHEWS, including protocols for validating and acting upon field reports and community acknowledgements, alert generation and approval processes, inter-agency coordination during emergencies, and procedures for warning dissemination through telecom operators, broadcasters, and other communication channels. The data-sharing framework shall enable timely, accurate, and secure dissemination of disaster-related information to NDMA decision-makers, partner institutions, and the public, in line with national governance arrangements and security requirements.
  • Build institutional capacity and ensure sustainability through comprehensive documentation, training, knowledge transfer, and handover, enabling NDMA to fully own, manage, maintain, and expand the system without reliance on proprietary licenses or vendor lock-in.
  • Deliver a fully tested, accepted, and operational EWS that complies with national policies and international best practices for multi-hazard early warning systems and supports Sierra Leone’s commitments to disaster risk reduction and early warnings for all.

SCENT Eswatini) Project. As part of its commitment to achieving universal access to modern energy services under Mission 300 and accelerating the transition away from traditional biomass, the Government intends to develop a National Clean Cooking Transition Strategy and Costed Implementation Plan. The Strategy will provide a comprehensive, evidence-based roadmap for increasing access to affordable, reliable and sustainable clean cooking solutions for households, institutions and commercial users, while strengthening policy, regulatory, market, financing and institutional frameworks. The MNRE now seeks to engage a qualified consulting firm or consortium to undertake this assignment. This assignment will also contribute to the implementation of the National Energy Compact.

a. Situational, institutional and market assessment for clean cooking.

To respond to the increasing needs and challenges in population administration and to utilize the strategic role of accurate population data, the Government of Indonesia has initiated comprehensive efforts to modernize and strengthen its system. This commitment is reflected in the launch of the project "ID for Inclusive Service Delivery and Digital Transformation in Indonesia," which aims to improve the population and civil registration framework and introduce secure digital identity solutions. Through this initiative, Indonesia seeks to ensure that all citizens and residents can access inclusive, efficient, and digitally integrated public and private services, thereby supporting national development goals and digital transformation.

In general, the scope of work for this consultant service includes:

I. Implementation of an Independent Public Satisfaction Survey (IKM). The Consulting Firm shall design and implement the Public Satisfaction Index (IKM) survey on population administration services, to be conducted twice:

  1. in 2026 as a baseline measurement, and
  2. in 2027 as a comparative survey to assess improvements in public satisfaction over time.

The Consulting Firm shall develop comprehensive recommendations to strengthen DG Dukcapil’s integrated Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system, ensuring that both citizens and institutional users have access to feedback mechanisms that are secure, traceable, and responsive, thereby supporting citizen-centric service delivery and enhancing service satisfaction.

The duration of project task implementation is estimated to be (14) fourteen months and the location of task implementation is located in Jakarta.

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be obtained at the address given below:

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSION OF INTEREST FOR THE SELECTION OF – FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT SPECIALIST /INDIVIDUAL CONSULTANT

          The Government of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, through the Government of Balochistan (GoB), with support of the World Bank (WB), is implementing the Balochistan Water Security and Productivity Improvement Project (BWSPIP). The project development objective is to improve flood protection, increase access to water for productive use, and improve water supply service delivery in selected areas of Balochistan. LE: files/world_bank_procurement_notice_OP00463071.html =====

GOVERNMENT OF SOMALILAND

MINISTRY OF LOCAL GOVERNMENT AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT (MoLGUD)

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSION OF INTEREST (REOI)

INDIVIDUAL CONSULTANT SELECTION

Country: Somaliland
Project ID: P508408
Project Name: Bulsho Project – Strengthening Community Institutions for Social Cohesion, Inclusion and Resilience
Consulting Service: PIU Bulsho Procurement Officer
Selection Type: Individual Consultant

Reference No: SO-MOLGUD-567779-CS-INDV
Duty Station: Hargeisa, Somaliland, with potential travel to the target districts and cities of the Bulsho Project
Duration: 12 months, renewable subject to satisfactory performance
Application Deadline: September 3, 2026, at 4:00 PM Hargeisa Time

1. BACKGROUND

The Ministry of Local Government and Urban Development (MoLGUD) of the Government of Somaliland is implementing the World Bank-financed Bulsho Project – Strengthening Community Institutions for Social Cohesion, Inclusion and Resilience (P508408).

The main obj

evant project requirements.

The Procurement Officer will coordinate and support procurement planning and implementation; preparation and processing of procurement documents; bid/proposal evaluation and contract award processes; contract management; procurement compliance, monitoring and reporting; community-level procurement; procurement capacity building; and maintenance of procurement records and systems, including the Systematic Tracking of Exchanges in Procurement (STEP).

The detailed scope of services, responsibilities, deliverables, reporting arrangements, and other requirements are provided in the attached Terms of Reference (TOR).

3. QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

The successful candidate shall meet the following minimum qualifications and experience:

  • A university degree from an accredited university in Procurement and Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, or an equivalent relevant discipline.
  • A minimum of six (6) years of directly relevant professional experience, including broad experience in the management of procurement in the public or private sector.
  • A minimum of four (4) years of experience implementing procurement activities in accordance with the procurement guidelines and

nd systems, including the Systematic Tracking of Exchanges in Procurement (STEP).

The detailed scope of services, responsibilities, deliverables, reporting arrangements, and other requirements are provided in the attached Terms of Reference (TOR).

3. QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE
